adaptations: Retain the actual access helper request ID and its separate complete captured-answer context; add independent missing service-class and security/operations inputs from the current service menu.
Batch A asks only service_tier; availability and recovery are already answered. No implicit SLA is added from the Standard recovery label.

Batch B offers compatible container-host choices and explicit Architect-guidance routes. The database pattern does not select SQL or Cosmos; the two store fields distinguish a primary-store alternative from a justified additional store.
No application_layers field: a web/database planning pattern is not an N-Tier or microservices selection; modular-monolith preference is already captured.

Reuse fictional data, authentication populations, private-client access, mandatory privacy/security controls, compliance distinction and region. Residency boundary and diagnostic retention are separate missing requirements, not reconfirmations.
Notification-channel intent is independent and will determine applicable Batch C platform/integration questions. Do not select or price a notification service now.
Defer Batch C supporting services until host/channel answers exist, then 3i reconciliation and 3j per-class SKU preferences. Do not add a resource just to fill the menu.
No live emails, names, identities, images, endpoints, application rule matrices or future Production topology are requested. Unknown/recommend answers are valid planning inputs.

form.message: Project Fulcrum — remaining dev platform intent. Captured: containerized backend, fictional data, employees plus external Volunteers, a new secure remote-access path, Sweden Central, Bicep, USD 500–2,000/month soft target, minimal cost monitoring and the stated recovery/performance objectives. Choose only known service preferences below; Not sure / Architect guidance is valid. Candidates are not approved architecture. Private API/data access, private DNS and security/privacy controls remain mandatory. No real contacts, identities, domains or endpoints. Dependent supporting-service and SKU questions follow only after scope is known.

service_tier.title: Dev platform — optimization profile
service_tier.description: Recommendation: cost-optimized for this small dev MVP, without weakening private access, security or captured recovery objectives. This is not a SKU selection or availability guarantee. A custom answer uses this same field.
enum: Cost-optimized
Balanced
Enterprise
Not sure — guide me

compute_host.title: Containerized backend — hosting preference
compute_host.description: Managed container hosting fits the simplicity preference. App Service hosts web/API containers; Container Apps manages container execution/scaling; AKS adds cluster operations. No Kubernetes need is assumed. The Architect evaluates feasibility, private access and cost. A custom answer uses this same field.
enum: App Service — Linux containers
Container Apps — managed containers
AKS — Kubernetes is specifically required
Functions — evaluate container compatibility
No host preference — Architect compare suitable managed container hosts
Not sure — guide me

relational_db.title: Primary application data — relational preference
relational_db.description: The captured web/database pattern does not require SQL. Select a known relational preference, or leave the primary data model to Architecture. No second database is implied. Application schema/design remains with the application team. A custom answer uses this same field.
enum: Azure SQL Database
PostgreSQL Flexible Server
MySQL Flexible Server
SQL Managed Instance — specific compatibility need
None — relational storage not required
Not sure — Architect evaluate one suitable primary store

non_relational_store.title: Application data — non-relational or cache need
non_relational_store.description: Cosmos DB was a candidate, not a decision. A document store may be an alternative primary store, not an automatic addition to SQL. Redis is an additional cache only for a stated need; prefer no extra store without justification. A custom answer can identify alternative versus additional use here.
enum: Cosmos DB — preferred primary document store
Azure Managed Redis — an additional cache is required
Azure Table Storage — simple key/value need
None — no non-relational store or cache required
Not sure — evaluate as an alternative, not an automatic extra store

storage_needs.title: Dev content — storage beyond the operational database
storage_needs.description: Select only known needs. Blob Storage was a candidate, not a confirmed requirement. Storage remains private with authenticated access; no public blobs. Choose None or Not sure alone when applicable. Custom needs use this same field.

enum: Blob storage — media or documents
Azure Files — file-share compatibility
Data Lake Storage Gen2 — analytics files
None — no additional storage required
Not sure — Architect evaluate the need without adding by default

notification_channels.title: Dev notifications — platform delivery intent
notification_channels.description: Notification capability is in scope, but email/push were only candidates. Choose required channel capabilities, or a simulation/guidance route alone. All dev payloads and accounts remain fictional; real recipients or device identifiers are not requested. Transport selection, safe delivery controls and app integration are later prerequisites.

enum: Email capability — fictional/dev testing only
Mobile push capability — fictional/dev testing only
Dev simulation only — no outbound delivery
Not sure — recommend suitable dev channel support

residency_requirement.title: Dev data — geographic boundary beyond the region preference
residency_requirement.description: Sweden Central is captured as the target region, not a confirmed residency boundary. A single-region boundary excludes cross-region replication. Identity, notifications and other global services need separate EU Data Boundary validation where relevant. No compliance certification is implied. A custom answer uses this same field.
enum: Single region — Sweden Central only
Sweden only — other Swedish regions may be evaluated
EU/EEA boundary — suitable European regions may be evaluated
No additional residency constraint beyond applicable law and effective policy
Not sure — identify implications and recommend

monitoring_network_requirement.title: Azure Monitor — connectivity requirement
monitoring_network_requirement.description: This choice applies only to Log Analytics and workspace-based Application Insights, not API/data/Storage/Key Vault/registry access. Effective policy may require private monitoring. Authentication, TLS and least privilege remain mandatory. A custom answer uses this same field.
enum: Authenticated public monitoring permitted if policy allows
Private-only monitoring is a known requirement
Not sure — follow policy and recommend

monitoring_access_scope.title: Dev monitoring — access responsibility
monitoring_access_scope.description: Capture platform scope only; operational alerts remain with minimal cost monitoring. No team/contact names, group IDs or exact alert bindings are needed during discovery. A custom answer uses this same field.
enum: Include suitable monitoring access in this project
An existing platform/team handles monitoring access
Not decided — carry this to Architecture

monitoring_privacy_retention.title: Dev diagnostics — retention intent
monitoring_privacy_retention.description: No real personal data, credentials or sensitive payloads may enter dev logs; minimization, redaction and restricted access are mandatory for every option. Choose a known diagnostic retention preference or request a justified recommendation. Audit/legal requirements and cost must be reconciled later. A custom answer uses this same field.
enum: 7 days for sanitized dev diagnostics
30 days for sanitized dev diagnostics
90 days for sanitized dev diagnostics
Use mandatory policy retention — duration not yet known
Not sure — recommend short-lived sanitized diagnostics

answers.industry: Nonprofit community support for vulnerable individuals and families; volunteer-led experiences and support
answers.budget_limit: Planning target — optimize and highlight overruns
answers.recovery_profile: Standard — recover within 4 hours; up to 1 hour of data loss
answers.performance_target: Typical API responses under 2 seconds — planning goal to validate
answers.private_client_access: A new secure remote-access path is needed
answers.authentication_requirement: Employees plus external Volunteers — fictional dev accounts
answers.current_delivery_scope: New dev-only hosting-platform MVP; first usable infrastructure within two weeks. Future Production is outside this delivery.
answers.current_delivery_data_constraint: Development uses fictional data only. Mandatory security/privacy baseline applies in dev; future Production GDPR requirement remains outside this dev delivery, with no compliance certification.
answers.system_description: Infrastructure-only hosting platform and cloud services for a secure, intuitive, mobile-first Volunteer engagement MVP, including support for a containerized backend. All application development is handled by another team and is out of scope.
answers.business_objective: Reduce manual coordination and administrative overhead; improve Volunteer engagement and matching, opportunity discovery, assignments, approvals, tracking, reporting, visibility and communication; accelerate assignments and grow without proportional administration.
answers.delivery_context: New MVP; pro bono initiative for The Organization. Existing coordination relies on calls, email, instant messaging, spreadsheets and manual approvals/follow-ups, causing overhead, low visibility and poor scalability. This is business context, not a migration request.
infrastructure_scope: Hosting support for a containerized backend; backend code excluded
Notification platform capabilities, with channels still to evaluate
Store anonymous resulting documentation in this repository
application_scope_exclusions: Detailed business workflow, escalation and reporting implementation
answers.application_role_constraints: Initial permission boundaries require Project Stakeholders validation. Manager is a functional role, not an identifiable party. Exact permissions and application implementation belong to another team.
answers.configurable_workflow_intent: Volunteer registration, participation approval, assignment confirmation, cancellations and changes. Exact rules and escalation remain undefined, belong to the application team, and do not block platform intake.
answers.operational_reporting_intent: Opportunities, registrations, assignment status, completed activities and participation. Detailed reports and impact metrics require application stakeholder confirmation.
answers.technology_evaluation_constraints: Candidates are not mandatory selections. Evaluate alternatives for suitability, security, simplicity, maintainability, scale and cost within limited nonprofit budgets; challenge complexity and avoid overengineering.
answers.design_preferences_not_decisions: Prefer managed services and a modular monolith; no microservices absent clear justification.
answers.data_processing_constraints: Personal Volunteer information and sensitive organizational activity may be processed. Beneficiary data is not assumed. Never use real personal information in development or testing; fictional sample data only.
security_privacy_requirements: Secure authentication and role-based access control
Encryption in transit and at rest
compliance: GDPR required for Production. MVP must be GDPR-aligned; the supplied brief says MVP does not have to be compliant. This release distinction does not waive applicable legal duties or mandatory security/privacy controls. Do not certify compliance.
anonymity_requirements: Anonymous generated source, documentation, commits, issues, pull requests, test data, infrastructure-as-code and artifacts
No customer/nonprofit or technology-partner names, individual names, real domains, organizational identifiers, correspondence or real beneficiary/Volunteer information
Use only generic party labels: The Organization, Technology Contributors, Volunteers, Coordinators, Administrators, Project Stakeholders
Do not request real names, personal emails, domains or identities during discovery
Do not publish repository remote URLs or account identities in project documentation
Author attribution uses agent role only; no people
answers.recommendation_provenance_requirement: Reasonable recommendations must be labelled Assumption/Recommendation, never represented as user-confirmed values or permission.
answers.sku_pin_evidence: No SKU locks were volunteered. This is not an explicit no-preference response and does not complete SKU elicitation.
answers.authorized_current_activity: Bounded Step 1 requirements discovery, anonymous documentation, validation and the required independent review through the interactive parent. No Azure reads or writes, credential operations, deployment, infrastructure code, application scaffolding, commits or pushes are authorized.
